How to read ✕

Job state

✓RunningRUNNING ◐StartingINITIALIZING, CREATED, RESTARTING, RECONCILING (question 6; red today) ✕MissingA required job the engine does not list. ✕Failed …FAILED, FAILING, CANCELED, CANCELLING, FINISHED, SUSPENDED

Numbers

UptimeSince the engine started the job. Checkpoint ageSince the job's last completed checkpoint; the tile shows the oldest. OK / failedCheckpoints since job start. Last fused verdictThe newest 12 h window that ended with a verdict, across the fleet (question 4). —Not read: the engine did not answer, or the job is not running. Never an estimate, never 0.

Not exposed

Watermark lag · Kafka consumer lag · Latency · Backpressure · ParallelismNot exposed by the proxy and not estimated.

Where a sample becomes a verdict

DCS / edge to Kafka, then Flink compute, then Postgres and IoTDB. Job lifecycle is owned by the supervisor; this page never starts or stops a job.
